title: 第5章 父子之间的小秘密
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这句话一出，就算莱恩真的不会飞行，祖国人也都无所谓了。

最关键之处在于他的儿子信任他。

为此他可爱的儿子莱恩，甚至会回绝贝卡这个女人的劝阻。

这让祖宝芳心大为感动。

无需多言，他周身难得地褪去了在沃特公司面对纷乱局势和白痴队友时的暴戾与焦躁，拿出了十足的耐心。

阿祖的目光温柔极了，那是从不会出现在他身上的神色。

落在莱恩身上，他鼓励道：“儿子，或许你的手臂应该再往上一点点。”

“是我的姿势不准确的原因吗？”

莱恩说完，不等祖国人回答便又道：“我从未做过，爸爸，你可以帮我看看还有哪里不对吗？”

“当然，我这就过来儿子，这里…这里…对对，就是这个角度。”

“再试一次。”

“好！”

贝卡看着眼前这荒唐的一幕心都快要碎了。

她亲爱的莱恩，居然与她刻骨铭心的仇人亲密无间，就在她眼前上演父子互动。

再也忍不下去了。

贝卡也不想再去忍受，她用一种诡异的平静语气，交代一句：“莱恩，累了就休息，妈妈去超市。”

“好的妈妈。”

之后，贝卡连看一眼祖国人都觉得恶心，转身就走。

开上车直接驶离社区，头也不回去就向沃特公司的首席科学家，也曾是祖国人项目的总负责人沃格尔鲍姆博士居住的庄园开去。

车子开出社区没多久，忽然贝卡的视线余光就从前方道路转移到了侧窗边远处的天空中。

那里，两道身影正相对缓慢地自由飞翔。

“吱呀——”

轮胎冒着青烟地被刹车死死抱住在地面摩擦。

贝卡惊骇且无助地捂住嘴，不可置信地囔囔自语：“不可能，莱恩他，他怎么会这么快就学会飞行！”

这是莱恩解锁飞行技能后头一次自由翱翔天际。

长风破开，周身被地球的重力拉扯着，让他的极致速度无法突破一级限制。

但那不重要！

此刻天高海阔，狂风裹着自由席卷全身，悬停下来的瞬间，一股酣畅淋漓的畅快直冲他心底。

整整八年，日复一日活在母亲的严密管控与无处不在的镜头下，收敛锋芒、压抑本性，乖乖扮演着乖巧孩童。

长久的隐忍与伪装早已压得他身心俱疲，内里积攒的压抑与狂躁几乎快要溢满，这般极致的压抑，本就绝非寻常人能够承受。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

As soon as these words came out, even if Ryan really couldn't fly, the people of the motherland didn't care.

The most important thing is that his son trusts him.

For this reason, his lovely son Ryan will even refuse the dissuasion of Becca, a woman.

This moved Zu Baofang greatly.

Needless to say, he rarely lost the violence and anxiety he had when facing chaotic situations and idiotic teammates in Watt Company, and showed full patience.

Azu's eyes were extremely gentle, a look that never appeared on him.

Falling on Ryan, he encouraged: "Son, maybe your arms should go up a little bit."

"Is it because my posture is inaccurate?"

After Ryan finished speaking, he added without waiting for the motherland's answer: "I've never done this before. Dad, can you help me see what's wrong?"

"Of course, I'll come over right away, son. Here...here...yes, this is the angle."

"Try again."

"Okay!"

Beca's heart almost broke when she saw this ridiculous scene in front of her.

Her beloved Ryan was actually so close to her unforgettable enemy that the father-son interaction was playing out right in front of her eyes.

I can't bear it anymore.

Beca didn't want to endure it anymore, so she said in a strangely calm tone: "Ryan, take a rest when you are tired, and mom will go to the supermarket."

"Okay mom."

After that, Beka felt sick even looking at the people from her motherland, so she turned around and left.

Get in the car and drive directly out of the community, without looking back, toward the manor where Dr. Vogelbaum, the chief scientist of Vought Corporation and the former head of the Motherland project, lives.

Not long after the car drove out of the community, Beca's peripheral vision suddenly shifted from the road ahead to the sky far away by the side window.

There, two figures were flying relatively slowly and freely.

"Squeak——"

The tires were smoking and clinging to the ground as the brakes clung to them.

Beca covered her mouth in shock and helplessness, muttering to herself in disbelief: "Impossible, Ryan, how could he learn to fly so quickly!"

This is the first time Ryan can fly freely after unlocking the flying skill.

Changfeng broke through, and his whole body was pulled by the earth's gravity, preventing his ultimate speed from breaking through the first-level limit.

But that's not important!

At this moment, the sky was high and the sea was vast, and the strong wind swept through him with freedom. The moment he paused, a hearty feeling of joy rushed straight into his heart.

For eight years, he lived under the strict control of his mother and the ubiquitous camera every day. He restrained his sharp edges, suppressed his nature, and acted obediently as a well-behaved child.

The long-term forbearance and pretense have already weighed him down physically and mentally, and the accumulated depression and mania is almost overflowing. Such extreme depression is definitely not something ordinary people can bear.
